{{Quote|Yes, I'll have another centipede, Mother, if you don't mind!|[[Waywa Fybot]], delirious from breaking both his legs|<ref name="Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref>}}
A '''centipede''' was a creature. The [[Quor'sav/Legends|Quor'sav]] of [[Uaua/Legends|Uaua]] were known to eat centipedes.<ref name="Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon" /> Centipedes were also present on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>
